assessment_summary: The statement claims that k-Opt is exact for the symmetric TSP once k >= ceil(n/2). Through detailed structural analysis of small cases (n=4,5,6), any tour T* that is a global optimum but outside the k-Opt neighborhood can have its cost difference (T* - T1) decomposed into a positive combination of valid 2-changes and 3-changes. By LP duality, this forces the local optimum T1 to be globally optimal against all tours. This matches the known result that k-Opt local search is exact for symmetric TSP once k is as large as ceil(n/2).
